title: Keep decoded video on the native overlay/display path

definition.title: Keep decoded video on the native overlay/display path
definition.source_excerpt: Question. Which practical display compositions preserve the least expensive native surface path? What differs from earlier work. Distinct from R08 CPU filter avoidance: investigate postdecode surfaces, compositor copies and hardware overlay eligibility. Input scope. Identical supported video and equivalent visible UI layouts on a recorded physical Chrome/GPU/display setup. Mechanism to test. Compare direct video presentation with equivalent composition arrangements, looking for decoder-surface-to-display routes that avoid unnecessary intermediate rendering. Smallest experiment. 1. Compare simple direct video, equivalent DOM overlays, transformed/occluded layouts and a canvas-routed control. 2. Use available browser traces and platform counters to establish actual paths rather than infer from CSS. 3. Repeat fullscreen/windowed and one multi-video case at equivalent visible content.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the CPU/GPU representation boundary and actual useful work removed. Check existing renderer fusions, caches, kernel fast paths and hardware gates.
definition.minimum_probe: Prerequisite-only first: Actual required API/format for any GPU claim; CPU algebra is a separate component observation, not browser qualification. If absent, record HOLD_ENV; if present, decide whether the small probe is warranted. Small deterministic planes/blocks or an existing real frame with one adversarial edge. Use a bounded component test if GPU integration is not already available, labeling it as such.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the CPU/GPU representation boundary and actual useful work removed. Check existing renderer fusions, caches, kernel fast paths and hardware gates. Small deterministic planes/blocks or an existing real frame with one adversarial edge. Use a bounded component test if GPU integration is not already available, labeling it as such.
definition.primary_metric: Complete decode/process/present cost, transfers, command work or peak live storage for identical requested output.
definition.scope_contract: Exact integer planes or an explicitly defined numerical/altered-output contract; compare the final requested region and later references where relevant.
definition.negative_control: Change stride, crop, phase, alpha, edge neighborhood or resource generation; exercise a case where the proposed shortcut is ineligible.
definition.stop_boundary: No custom decoder rewrite or GPU platform port. Include staging/readback/cache cost; reject the current implementation rather than the general idea if the executor is a proxy.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Actual required API/format for any GPU claim; CPU algebra is a separate component observation, not browser qualification.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.

related_keys.note: Overlay eligibility; platform and requested visual features determine equivalence.

definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

prepare.basis: Fresh owned headful Chrome 152 on Apple M1 / ANGLE Metal and the online built-in 2560x1600 Color LCD establishes that the former physical-display-absent/headless-only prerequisite description is stale. Expanded Chrome tracing records 95 Display::FrameDisplayed events, 95 native CoreAnimation commits and scheduled overlay layer count 9; these are not hardware promotion or source-frame scanout proof. Actual Instruments Metal System Trace succeeds after increasing startup budget from 25 to 75 seconds; the first timed-out incomplete trace is retained, not called permission denial. Exported displayed-surfaces-interval has 260 physical surface intervals and Direct to Display=false for all, but no Chrome source attribution: generic compositor surface labels and some unrelated process labels, no source VideoFrame/PTS identity. Surface queue export has swap IDs, no source mapping; ca-client-present-request and compositor-event tables have schemas but no rows. Therefore neither overlay eligibility nor source-frame cadence has passed or failed. Physical telemetry is accessible; the remaining prerequisite is a controlled foreground source-to-IOSurface mapping and application-owner comparison, a setup gap, not absent GPU, absent display, or an experimental negative. Browser and owned recorder are closed. No power, subtitle composition, custom presenter cadence, fidelity or comparative performance claim. Implement a source-frame/PTS to IOSurface attribution bridge and compare native video against equivalent canvas presentation on this actual display; validate promotion plus output before a cost comparison.
